## What changed

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Risk and trust checklist

- [ ] I did not include secrets, private text, proprietary code/assets, or opaque project binaries.
- [ ] I disclosed any new dependency, network transfer, permission, persistent data, installer, or release-workflow change.
- [ ] User interaction still takes priority over background detection.
- [ ] Closing a popup cannot reopen it repeatedly for the same still-active selection.
- [ ] Translation is not requested until the user chooses a translation action.
- [ ] I updated tests and public documentation where behavior changed.
- [ ] I ran the relevant local checks and reviewed their results.
